metadata.title: ISPE Strategic Plan Progress Tracker
metadata.subtitle: Dashboard Progress of Strategic Plan Objectives

objectives.title: Objective 1
objectives.description: Inspire ISPE members and leaders to engage with emerging and innovative topics - to learn about the topic, advocate scientific policy, facilitate collaboration, and to drive application and integration into practice

goals.description: Goal 1.1: Throughout 2024-2029, continue transparent calls for leaders and members to engage in strategic efforts

tactics.description: Engage ISPE communities and members to lead strategic efforts through a transparent solicitation to all members
Organize joint meetings among leaders of SIGs, RIGs, and other communities as appropriate to promote collaboration in leading strategic efforts
Create opportunities for leadership through a special call for mid-career members
Provide feedback to the ISPE communities and members on all ongoing strategic efforts and the lead groups involved

goals.description: Goal 1.2: Throughout 2025-2029, >50% of plenaries, symposia/workshops at each meeting, webinars, and engagements with collaborating organizations and at least two pre-conference courses per year are related to emerging and innovative topics and/or strategic efforts

tactics.description: Solicit a society-wide call for pre-conference course content related to an ISPE strategic effort.

Develop a plan for plenaries, symposia, and workshops on topics related to strategic efforts at ISPE-sponsored meetings by designating a strategic effort topic within the annual solicitation for plenary topics and listing strategic effort topic(s) as a special area of interest in the call for symposia and workshops.
Leverage ISPE strategic liaisons to develop a webinar with a collaborating organization related to a strategic effort
Develop preconference program that includes courses related to strategic efforts
Solicit webinars related to strategic efforts

new_tactics.description: Yes. two new tactics have been added:   -	Develop preconference program that includes courses related to strategic efforts -	Solicit webinars related to strategic efforts.

objectives.title: Objective 2
objectives.description: Share past successes, expertise, and innovation while leading novel integrations of epidemiology and public health in the development, research, and use of medical products and interventions

goals.description: Goal 2.1: By 2025, establish a communication plan which emphasizes publicizing achievements aligned with this strategic plan, internal and external to ISPE

tactics.description: Reserve and use a designated space within the quarterly newsletter to ISPE members to communicate achievements related to the strategic plan
Learn from the experience of the History and Archives Committee about how they have highlighted past achievements and how that can be used going forward for this plan

Provide annual updates to membership through presentations at the annual and regional ISPE meetings (via Presidential address or organized symposia). These presentations can highlight major achievements from the strategic plan
Leverage existing strategic partnerships to disseminate achievements related to this strategic plan (e.g., through conference presentatins/symposia, joint publications, etc.)
tactics.notes: The tactic is not at risk. We have brainstormed ways to engage external partners in promoting achievements from strategic plan. One mechanism is a paper about advocacy in pharmacoepi, coauthored by Grammati Sarri and Mehmet Burcu and others. More time is needed to explore how and where to distribute these accomplishments among strategic partner organizations.

tactics.description: Organize an ongoing special collection in PDS to highlight relevant strategic plan achievements throughout the year
tactics.notes: The tactic is not at risk. We have confirmed PDS' interest in publishing such information. We have obtained drafts of ISPE history manuscripts. We have reached out to student groups to assess interest in refining these into shorter components for publication.

tactics.description: Plan bi-annual LinkedIn spotlights related to achievements for the strategic plan

goals.description: Goal 2.2: By 2029, develop at least 5 position statements from ISPE showcasing expertise and innovation in pharmacoepidemiology

tactics.description: Develop a subgroup within the ISPE Board that will lead and organize the identification, development, selection, direction, and dissemination of the ISPE position statement initiatives.
tactics.revised_description: As the ISPE Manuscript Initiative was on pause the last year, no actions were taken

tactics.description: Establish an annual call for ISPE Position Statements (within the current ISPE Manuscript Initiative) where ISPE Working Groups could apply for funding that is in line with the strategic plan and relevant to external audiences.
tactics.revised_description: The ISPE Manuscript Initiative was on hold the precious year so the tactic was changed. It may come to fruition in the coming year

tactics.description: Pursue ISPE endorsement and joint publication between PDS and another relevant journal to expand the reach of the position statements
Create a press release and wider dissemination strategy for ISPE endorsed policy
tactics.notes: No, the tactic is scheduled for later in the Strategic Planning

tactics.description: Host one ISPE webinar annually following the publication of ISPE position statements to enhance dissemination
tactics.revised_description: As there was no ISPE Manuscript Initiative this year, this is on pause for the time being

objectives.title: Objective 3
objectives.description: Maximize utility and flexibility of organizational structure and activities to achieve mission and vision in a timely and efficient fashion

goals.description: Goal 3.1: By 2026, complete a review of the organization structure and activities of ISPE; by 2028, implement any needed modifications to enhance future opportunities to achieve mission and vision

tactics.description: Onboard the new management company and identify major pain points
Compile a list of ISPE activities noting (a) who is responsible for each activity; (b) timing of each activity; (c) assessment of whether the activity is optimally aligned with the responsible group.
Develop a more detailed organizational chart, including communication pathways between groups
Identify gaps (gaps and prioritization analysis), via survey that all community leaders will be invited to contribute; prioritize gaps based on finalized list of gaps.
tactics.revised_description: overcome and included in the new tactic 3.1.8

tactics.description: Finalize list of recommended changes and develop outcome indicators for each change
tactics.revised_description: overcome and included in the new tactic 3.1.8

tactics.description: Develop a timeline for implementation
tactics.revised_description: overcome and included in the new tactic 3.1.8

tactics.description: Successfully implement the needed modifications of the organizational structure
tactics.revised_description: overcome and included in the new tactic 3.1.8

new_tactics.description: The new tactic proposed to replace tactics 3.1.4-3.1.7.  The management company in collaboration with the Executive committee and ISPE communities identifies gaps on an ongoing basis. Suitable solutions are developed and implemented ad hoc involving the interested parties in ISPE. All ISPE community leaders have the opportunity to report gaps or any other needs through a dedicated form.

goals.description: Goal 3.2: Revised: Implement onboarding for members and leaders to facilitate clear understanding of expectations, provide transparency and information flow, and encourage engagement aligned with ISPE mission, vision, and strategic plan

tactics.description: Review current onboarding process (e.g., who receives onboarding, timeline during the year and who is responsible for each onboarding, location of onboarding materials)

Develop central repository for editable onboarding materials for new leaders/strategic liaisons, board members, new members , and FISPEs and SISPEs , accessible throughout the year. Upload non-editable versions of onboarding materials on the ISPE website and in the ISPE meeting App to be accessible by all ISPE members

Identify gaps and potential areas of improvement (e.g., clarify what it means to be on the board, etc.) through review and via feedback from targeted surveys or online questionnaires to collect feedback from ISPE members who recently received onboarding.
Finalize/develop new onboarding material for FISPEs and SISPEs, also considering the feedback received from above surveys.
Develop updated slide decks, as needed, incorporating feedback and addressing identified gaps and areas of improvement on an annual basis
Consider whether it is appropriate for any of (or all) these activities to transition to the management company

objectives.title: Objective 4
objectives.description: To identify and utilize opportunities to diversify financial and resource investments to further the ISPE mission and strategic activities that are aligned with our future vision

goals.description: Goal 4.1: By 2029, at least 40% of revenue generation is through channels not yet included in ISPE portfolio

tactics.description: Compile a list of options for additional funding/revenue that other professional societies and organizations allow (e.g., ISPOR, DIA, SER) such as sponsored activities, endowments, grants, etc
tactics.notes: Emails have been sent to ISPE Liaisons who will then send the email to their organizations. We hope to have responses back by early September.  Then we will move onto Tactic 4.1.2.

tactics.description: Analyze and use report to determine next steps regarding new channels of funding/revenue
Get approval from Board on proposals for new funding channels.
Task relevant ISPE committees/communities with implementing
Develop a timeline for implementation
Successfully implement the new channels

goals.description: Goal 4.2: By 2026, improve ISPE technology resources and practices to streamline communication and procedures

tactics.description: Onboard the new management company and identify major pain points of technology

Prioritize key technology challenges and develop proposals on the solutions to technology challenges that include proposed budgets. This includes exploring options to improve the online member platform (ISPE exchange) and/or transition to another platform with more capabilities.
After each technology upgrade/change/solution is implemented, develop metrics that demonstrate measurable improvement
tactics.notes: not at risk, new Exec rep will work with IMPACT in autumn 2026

tactics.description: Provide a one page document regarding ISPE-wide technology platforms to be used.

objectives.title: Objective 5
objectives.description: Increase opportunities for engagement and enhance leadership capacity for scientific exchange, collaboration, and communication globally and across disciplines

goals.description: Goal 5.1: Revised Goal: Intentionally incorporate capacity-building within and across ISPE communities, and into all ISPE strategic activities

tactics.description: RIGs, SIGs, and Open Committees will include a breakdown of student and early career professional participation in annual reports
RIGs, SIGs, Committees, Councils will include a breakdown of early career professional participation in annual reports
Create an annual award to ISPE RiGs, SIGs, and Committees that demonstrated successful recruitment and member retention outlined in their annual report to the Board
RIGs, SIGs, Committees, Councils will report detailed updates on their efforts to attract and increase membership among ISPE members, with a focus on capacity-building
Encourage RIGs, SIGs, Committees, Councils to develop targeted outreach campaigns during ISPE's annual meeting to boost participation and recruit new members
Ensure capacity-building requirements are included in strategic effort guidelines and champion responsibilities.
Revise initiative funding proposal guidelines to include capacity- building elements.

goals.description: Goal 5.2: By 2026, establish virtual meeting engagement practices for conferences and ISPE community meetings

tactics.description: The P&CC will revise their policies to promote active engagement on social media during ISPE events, e.g., paid ads for annual meeting.
Develop a hybrid component for the annual meeting, ensuring that both in-person and virtual attendees can fully participate in discussions, presentations, and networking opportunities

Create a subcommittee within Meetings Oversight Committee, specifically tasked with identifying and implementing strategies to boost engagement for virtual attendees. The subcommittee will experiment with various formats such as breakout sessions, networking lounges, and live chat rooms to keep virtual attendees engaged
Create virtual discussion fora for members to discuss research papers or other pressing topics throughout the year
tactics.notes: Tactic is not at risk

tactics.description: Require all communities to incorporate virtual components into their activities, allowing for distant live participation during ISPE meetings when the IT capacity exists at a reasonable cost and the expenses are affordable to ISPE (the potential negative financial consequence is acceptable to ISPE)

goals.description: Goal 5.3: By 2029, award at least 5 new FISPE to members from Africa, LATAM, and Gulf regions

tactics.description: Recruit at least two FISPE volunteers to mentor candidates from Africa, Latin America, and Gulf regions via RIGs—providing guidance on criteria and applications—and require RIGs to promote the FISPE program to near-eligible members in these regions with clear communication and mentorship to encourage applications
tactics.notes: Will be completed next year.  Initiated discussion in committee this year.

tactics.description: Encourage RIGs to identify potential FISPE candidates early and work with them to ensure they meet the necessary qualifications through involvement in ISPE activities and leadership roles
Ensure that the FISPE criteria, application guidelines, and related policies are translated into key languages spoken in Africa, LATAM, and the Gulf regions

Explore the possibility of customized or reduced fees for ISPE annual meetings and memberships for members from Low-Income and Lower-Middle Income Economies defined by World Bank. Create a discount option for membership when five or more new members from the same region join ISPE together

Ask the Membership Committee and the Student Council to form a subcommittee focused on the engagement and recruitment of members from underrepresented regions, particularly in Africa, LATAM, and the Gulf. This subcommittee will develop strategies to attract new members from these regions and ensure their long-term involvement in ISPE activities, including support for FISPE candidacies

objectives.title: Objective 6
objectives.description: Create diverse development opportunities for all stages of career, with emphasis on creating new opportunities for early and mid-career while maintaining opportunities for students

tactics.description: Generate an initial list of opportunities for FISPE engagement based on historical data and input from ISPE Community Leaders. The list should include specific details on time and level of commitment.
Survey FISPEs to collect feedback on the proposed list (see Tactic 6.1.1) and finalize list of opportunities for engagement
Focus groups with FISPEs to gather more detailed feedback and plan for implementation.
Develop communication strategies to engage FISPEs- include plan, communication of expectations, and implementation of the pledge framework for FISPE engagement.
Update the opportunities pathway to include additional information for ISPE members, including FISPEs to become actively engaged
Create a standardized process for streamlined communication of need for FISPE engagement from ISPE communities

tactics.description: Update the opportunities pathway to include additional information for all ISPE members to become actively engaged

objectives.title: Objective 8
objectives.description: Engage external partnerships to ensure that ISPE as an organization is included in global conversations about conduct of pharmacoepidemiology studies and translation of results into public health policy and clinical practice

goals.description: Goal 8.1: Revised Goal: Develop and implement plan to increase advocacy globally that accounts for differing context and needs

tactics.description: Establish a working group to develop and implement a plan to oversee engagement with strategic liaisons, increase advocacy and interactions with external partners globally. Working group will report to the Exec (in lieu of Board) and to Board twice per year (April & August).

Initiation of an audit, gap and needs analysis of ISPEs ongoing global partnership activities and identify relevant partners for the society. This will align with existing partnerships to evaluate value and ensure adoption of processes.
tactics.notes: Not at risk. The working group will be launched right after ISPE 2026 annual meeting. The WG will execute the remaining tactics under PPC monitor. The timelines for tactics 2-4 are built accordingly.  We intentionally timed this process to align with the annual meeting, since leadership transitions occur across many communities during that period. For this reason, the first working group meeting will take place after the annual meeting.   This tactic will be carried forward by the working group over a 12–18 month timeline, with support and monitoring from PPC and this core team as needed.

tactics.description: Development of plan for society to increase global strategic partnerships. The developed plan will consider i) a partnership model for each category of partner (e.g. medical society, patient advocacy groups) ii) a communications plan to ensure increased communication within and beyond the society on partnership activities, including utilizing social media, newsletters and the ISPE website. An external partner’s page on the ISPE website is recommended to advertise current partners and facilitate contact details for requests directly to the society from new partners.
tactics.notes: Not at risk. The working group will be launched right after ISPE 2026 annual meeting. The WG will execute the remaining tactics under PPC monitor. The timelines for tactics 2-4 are built accordingly.  We intentionally timed this process to align with the annual meeting, since leadership transitions occur across many communities during that period. For this reason, the first working group meeting will take place after the annual meeting.   This tactic will be carried forward by the working group over a 12–18 month timeline, with support and monitoring from PPC and this core team as needed.

tactics.description: Implementation of plan; Clear objectives and roadmap will be set. Select key partners in currently underrepresented regions or subregions to test/pilot strategies. Progress will be tracked through regular monitoring of efforts. Feedback mechanism will be established from external partners.
tactics.notes: Not at risk. The working group will be launched right after ISPE 2026 annual meeting. The WG will execute the remaining tactics under PPC monitor. The timelines for tactics 2-4 are built accordingly. For this reason, the first working group meeting will take place after the annual meeting.   This tactic will be carried forward by the working group over a 12–18 month timeline, with support and monitoring from PPC and this core team as needed.
